claim: vib133 contains a mutation (AG->TG) at the splice acceptor site of its last intron
source: vib133 contains a mutation (AG->TG) at the splice acceptor site of its last intron (Figure 1A)

claim: Hemizygous vib133 or vib1105 over deficiency Df(3R)BSC850 survived to 2nd instar larval stage
source: Hemizygous vib133 or vib1105 over deficiency Df(3R)BSC850 survived to 2nd instar larval stage, similar to hemizygous vibj7A3, a reported protein null allele, over a deficiency Df(3R)Dl-BX12 (Gatt and Glover, 2006).
evidence: Direct observation of larval survival stages reported in the manuscript

claim: Vib protein levels in vib133/Df(3R)BSC850 were reduced to 9% compared with control

claim: Vib protein levels in vib1105/Df(3R)BSC850 were reduced to 9% compared with control
source: Vib protein levels with the predicted size 32 KDa in the larval brains of hemizygous vib133/Df(3R)BSC850 and vib1105/Df(3R)BSC850 were both significantly reduced to 9% compared with control (Figure 1—figure supplement 1A, n = 2).
evidence: Western blot data shown in Figure 1—figure supplement 1A quantifying Vib protein levels

claim: vib133 and vib1105 are most likely strong hypomorphic alleles
source: Taken together, these results suggest that vib133 and vib1105 are most likely strong hypomorphic alleles.
evidence: Inference based on protein level reduction and survival data presented in the manuscript
